SS-DISTRIBUTION.Purpose: Build and distribute standalone native Codex and DeepSeek Harness plugin bundles.

Scope.SCP-IN-001: Linux x86_64; local checkout, development install, offline packages, manual release.
Scope.SCP-IN-002: Repository scripts/ tasks; separate Core, adapters, classifier, canonical skills.
Scope.SCP-OUT-001: No automatic project initialization, Git update, CI provider, or global semantic prompt.

Principles.PRIN-001: Bundling does not couple independent components.
Principles.PRIN-002: Installed binaries have no development toolchain requirement.
Principles.PRIN-003: DSH plugin bundle is the artifact; user profiles are not distribution units.

Requirements.REQ-001: One native bundle per harness contains Core, adapter, and canonical skills.
Requirements.REQ-002: Core can build independently of model frameworks and provider credentials.
Requirements.REQ-003: Packages contain prebuilt components, exact skills, complete deterministic SHA256 manifests.
Requirements.REQ-004: Offline package verification does not require network, dependency resolution, or model inference.
Requirements.REQ-005: Codex development installation uses separate frostline-local marketplace; DSH development installation uses native bundle linking in an existing user profile.
Requirements.REQ-006: Local installation never updates the Git checkout; no GitHub Actions or automatic publishing.
Requirements.REQ-007: DSH compatibility is the exactly tested upstream revision declared in package peerDependencies, never an inferred broad range or fork compatibility.
Requirements.REQ-008: Local release stages a Codex Git marketplace with binaries and DSH npm-compatible tarball; release does not publish.

SS-DISTRIBUTION.Codemap: * `scripts/build.sh` -> `packages/core` -> `fli` + `packages/read-classifier` -> `fli-classify-reads` + `integrations/codex/native` -> `frostline-codex` * `scripts/licenses.ts` -> `cargo metadata` -> `licenses/NOTICE.md` + `licenses/<SPDX>.txt` * `scripts/package.sh` -> codex bundle + dsh bundle + `manifest.sha256` * `scripts/verify.sh` -> `manifest.sha256` + `licenses/NOTICE.md` + lockfile crates coverage * `scripts/install-dev.sh` -> native codex plugin + native dsh bundle * `scripts/release.sh` -> `scripts/package.sh` + `scripts/verify.sh` -> codex marketplace + dsh .tgz
